p-ranav/indicators
===================

Vendored header-only progress indicator library.

Source:
https://github.com/p-ranav/indicators

Vendored version:
v2.3

Files:
indicators.hpp - copied from single_include/indicators/indicators.hpp
LICENCE.txt - indicators MIT licence
LICENCE.termcolor.txt - bundled termcolor licence

Integration:
modules/progressbar.hpp includes indicators.hpp and exposes it as
ign::progressbar.
